rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet, line 1: "Enter the total of all collectibles gain or (loss) from items you reported on Form 8949, Part II". Collectibles on Form 8949 Part II are refused at the sale by sales.special ("Does this sale involve collectibles ..., qualified small business stock with a section 1202 exclusion, depreciable real property (section 1250 property), or an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust holding such property?"), through sales.one, before any Schedule D total (checked: sales[s2].special true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, g28.line7, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused). Line 1 is $0.00 only behind that refusal. The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it. The line is shown only when Schedule D line 17 is Yes (BUG-0183), which the reviewer did not contest. No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet, line 2: "Enter as a positive number the total of: • Any section 1202 exclusion you reported in column (g) of Form 8949, Part II, with code “Q” in column (f), that is 50% of the gain; ...". A code Q exclusion arises from a sale of qualified small business stock, refused at the sale by sales.special ("Does this sale involve collectibles ..., qualified small business stock with a section 1202 exclusion, depreciable real property (section 1250 property), or an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust holding such property?") (checked: sales[s2].special true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, g28.line7, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused); from Form 1099-DIV box 2c, refused by div.section1202 ("Form 8949 code Q / Form 6251"); or from a Schedule K-1, refused by sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1? ..."). The reviewer's claim that the refusal "covers only section 1202 distributions" overlooks sales.special. Line 2 is $0.00 only behind these refusals. The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it. The line is shown only when Schedule D line 17 is Yes (BUG-0183), which the reviewer did not contest. No change to the data.

The Schedule D line 14 part is the representation the page asks: since Stage 20 the line copies Schedule D line 14, the worksheet result held negative ("a loss, negative"), and line 7 combines it as a loss (constructed return: 2024 Schedule D line 15 -$10,000 and line 21 $3,000, box 2d $400, line 17 Yes: line 5 -$10,000.00, line 7 $0.00). A Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 11 code D carryover is a capital loss on a Schedule K-1, refused by sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1? ...") and by scope.schedule1 ("... sales of business property (Form 4797); ... partnerships, S corporations, estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1) ..."); sd.line14 itself refuses on sd.other_forms (checked: sd.other_forms true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, sd.line14, g28.line5, g28.line7, u1250.line16, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused). The project's English says so ("is refused by the Schedule D screen"). The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it. The line is shown only when Schedule D line 17 is Yes (BUG-0183), which the reviewer did not contest. No change to the data.
